Questions

Is it really free?

Yes. There's nothing to pay and no card details. The site is paid for by affiliate commissions, which we always label.

What emails will I get?

The kit straight away, then three short emails over the next fortnight to help you get ready, a reminder 7 days before each quarterly update and tax return deadline (around 5 or 6 a year), and occasional MTD news when HMRC changes something important.

Why do you ask "I am a…"?

It's optional. It lets us leave out reminders that don't apply to you, for example landlord-only points if you're a sole trader.

Will you pass my details to anyone?

No. We never sell or share your details. Our email service stores them for us under contract. If we ever offer to put you in touch with an accountant, that will be a separate request you choose to make.

Can I unsubscribe?

Yes, with one click at the bottom of every email. We then stop emailing you straight away.

Is this tax advice?

No. It's general information taken from GOV.UK, with links to every source. Check your own position on GOV.UK or with a qualified adviser.
